title: centaurea phrygia subsp. indurata
intro: Centaurea phrygia subsp. indurata, commonly known as Kermes oak or Kermes oak centaury, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Turkey, for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Centaurea phrygia subsp. indurata include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer properties.
